title: Supaste — Clipboard History Manager for Mac
description: Supaste is a local-first clipboard and screenshot history app for Mac. Save copied text, links, images, files, code, colors, and screenshots in a beautiful searchable timeline.
text:
Supaste saves your clipboard and screenshots in a beautiful visual history, automatically grouped by type, app, and custom categories, so you can search, find, and paste anything back in seconds.

Fully offline and privacy

macOS Sonoma 14.0 or later

Your clipboard, wherever you need it

Use the notch shelf, quick search, inline paste, drag and drop, and the full Library view to find, reuse, and organize anything you copied.

Smarter, Faster, and Connected Across Your Mac

Keep your clipboard synced with iCloud, automatically organize clips with Smart Auto-Filter, share files instantly through Dropbox, and rewrite or summarize text using Apple Intelligence.

One Beautiful Place for Everything You Save

Keep your clipboard history, colors, icons, assets, images, text, and important saves beautifully organized in one place. Instantly preview, copy, and access anything with keyboard shortcuts, customize Supaste to fit your workflow, and use built-in tools like Color Picker, Text Capture, Quick Notes, and more — all without leaving what you’re working on.

I've been using Supaste now for a week and I LOVE It. I've been looking for this my entire career. I've tried other clipboard apps that just have a running list, but the visual and category aspect to this app is amazing. I also love that it's a part of the notch. And finding previous copies by searching, app, or type of content is insanely useful.

Lead Designer & Developer

Reuse Anything Without Switching Apps

Keep your most useful clips right at the top of your Mac. Drag images, assets, text, colors, SVG icons, screenshots, and files directly from the notch into any app, without opening another window or switching context.

I’ve been searching for a productivity app that makes daily tasks easier for ages. I tried a ton of them, but they always felt incomplete—then I stumbled upon Supaste. Great design, sleek and intuitive, with so many useful extra features. My search is finally over!

Take a screenshot or copy an image, and Supaste automatically recognizes the text inside it. Search for words, notes, receipts, error messages, or anything visible in an image, and find it again in seconds.

Copy multiple items from different apps and content types into one combined clip card. Collect text, links, images, files, code, and more, then paste everything together anywhere, anytime.

Create a quick shortcut for any clip, like ;welcome, and type it anywhere to instantly insert your saved text, link, template, or clip. No app switching, no window opening — just type your shortcut and Supaste replaces it with your content.

Set reminders on any clip — text, files, images, links, screenshots, or anything you save. Choose a quick time, pick a custom date, or get reminded when you return to the app where the item was originally copied from.

Press Control + Command + V in any app to open Supaste instantly. Search your clipboard, templates, screenshots, links, code, and saved items, then paste what you need without breaking your flow.

See your clipboard as a clean visual timeline, then open the full Library window to browse, organize, manage, and reuse your saved text, links, screenshots, images, code, colors, files, and assets.

Your Last 10 Clips, One Keystroke Away

Use Control + Command + 0–9 to bring back recent text, links, images, code, colors, files, or screenshots without opening a window or changing apps.

Create your own spaces for projects, templates, brand assets, and everyday snippets. Organize email replies, text blocks, logos, icons, colors, files, and anything else you want to find and reuse quickly.

Filter your history by the app it came from or the kind of content it is. Quickly find clips from Safari, Figma, Slack, Xcode, or Mail, and browse by text, links, screenshots, images, files, code, colors, and more.

Built for everything you copy

From code snippets and design assets to customer replies, screenshots, links, and personal notes, Supaste keeps every useful piece of your clipboard organized and ready to reuse.

Keep colors, icons, screenshots, SVGs, gradients, visual references, and assets close at hand in a beautiful searchable shelf.

Save code snippets, commands, errors, JSON, API responses, and GitHub links automatically, then find and paste them back whenever you need them.

Capture hooks, taglines, SEO keywords, drafts, research links, screenshots, and campaign ideas before they disappear from your clipboard.

Reuse your best replies, email templates, product links, customer notes, and support screenshots without digging through old conversations.

Organize investor notes, product ideas, competitor screenshots, pricing pages, links, and daily research in one visual history.

Find copied links, addresses, tracking numbers, images, screenshots, recipes, quotes, and anything else you meant to save.

One price.Lifetime access.

One-time payment. No subscription.Get lifetime access to Supaste on your Mac.
